name: The Tower
note: The old one at the centre. Fixed: the grammar builds around it, never over it.

name: Sanctum
note: The plaza ring around the tower: lanterns, purification basins, a few small halls.

name: University
note: One university on the terrace below the tower, cloisters round courtyards.

name: Library
note: The university's library, one tall block.

name: Terrace gardens
note: Recreation gardens: moss, raked gravel, trees. Whatever the university doesn't take.

name: Villas
note: The wealthy, high up: bigger houses round private courtyards.

name: Pocket gardens
note: Small public gardens between the villas.

name: Elementary school
note: Small schools spread through the town, each with a yard.

name: Dense housing
note: The many, low down: tall narrow houses on tight lanes.

name: Market
note: Open squares where an avenue crosses the middle of the lower town. Stalls, wells.

name: Craft quarter
note: Workshops and granaries by the wall.

name: Shrine
note: Small shrines to the revered species, built round a tree, rock or spring.

name: Canal
note: A water ring through the lower town (span = which ring of lots); bridges where the avenues cross.
